title: confed attach result
description: The `result` of `confed attach --json`. It has three shapes: files copied into the page's sidecar directory (and, with --push, uploaded); `--list`, the page's attachments from the local state or, with --remote, from the server; and `--rm`, one attachment removed locally and, with --push, on the server.

page_id.description: The page the attachments hang off.

attached.description: The files now in the sidecar directory, in the order given.

file.description: Its file name in the sidecar directory.

source.description: `cache`: the local state, as fresh as the last fetch. `server`: asked of the server just now (--remote).

last_fetch_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last fetch, or null if the space has never been fetched.

id.description: The attachment's id on the server.

sha256.description: `cache` only: hex SHA-256 of the downloaded file.

downloaded.description: `cache` only: this version of the file has been pulled here.

removed_locally.description: The file was in the sidecar directory and is now gone.

removed_on_server.description: Deleted on the server by this run (--push).

staged.description: Still an attachment on the server: removed here only. A plain `confed push` holds the deletion back; it takes `--allow-delete`.

needs.description: Present when staged without --push: the flag `confed push` needs to delete it on the server.

push_outcome.description: With --push: the push of the page, shaped as the `result` of `confed push --json` (see push.schema.json).
